Incoterms 2020

Terminal Nombrado

A specific port terminal appointed by the carrier, shipper, or contract terms for loading or unloading cargo, subject to operational planning and contractual designation.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Terminal Nombrado?

In this glossary, Terminal Nombrado refers to: A specific port terminal appointed by the carrier, shipper, or contract terms for loading or unloading cargo, subject to operational planning and contractual designation.

How is Terminal Nombrado used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "El conocimiento de embarque especifica el terminal nombrado donde deben entregarse todos los contenedores para su carga en el buque."

Definition

A specific port terminal appointed by the carrier, shipper, or contract terms for loading or unloading cargo, subject to operational planning and contractual designation.

Operational example

The bill of lading specifies the nominated terminal where all containers must be delivered for loading onto the vessel.

Localized term

Terminal Nombrado

Localized example

El conocimiento de embarque especifica el terminal nombrado donde deben entregarse todos los contenedores para su carga en el buque.
